guide.title: 参与前安全检查
guide.description: 核对官方域名后再操作。请使用专用的独立空投钱包，任何时候都不要输入助记词或私钥。任何要求你输入助记词、私钥或向个人地址转账的页面都是骗局。
guide.done_when: 已确认官方域名，并准备好专用的独立空投钱包。

guide.title: 创建 Cambria 账号
guide.description: 访问 Cambria 大厅并创建一个账户。注册时使用邀请码 9df14149，这样你和被邀请人就能在未来的活动中获得积分。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: Visit the Cambria lobby and set up an account. Use invite code 9df14149 at sign-up, which gives both you and the referrer a points boost on future activity.

guide.title: 绑定你的钱包
guide.description: 从你的账户设置中连接 EVM 钱包、Solana 钱包和 Abstract 钱包。Cambria 在计算你的 Degen 和 Chad 分数时会检查这三者的活动，因此即使你只打算在一个链上玩，将所有活动联系起来也很重要。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: Connect an EVM wallet, a Solana wallet, and an Abstract wallet from your account settings. Cambria checks activity across all three when it calculates your Degen and Chad Scores, so linking all of them matters even if you only plan to play on one chain.

guide.title: 查看你的战利品宝箱资格
guide.description: 关联钱包后，请前往理赔仪表盘查看你的 Degen 分数和 Chad 分数，以及你已获得资格的任何战利品。你的护理套餐规模根据你的退化分数进行调整： Solana 交易活动（memecoins、DeFi、预测市场）多元市场交易活动多链风险承担（perps、期权、NFT 交易）退化相邻资产的时间加权持仓值得注意的社区参与
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: Once your wallets are linked, head to the claims dashboard to see your Degen Score and Chad Score, along with any Loot Chests you’ve already qualified for. Your Care Package size scales based on your degen score across: Solana trading activity (memecoins, DeFi, prediction markets) Polymarket trading activity Multi-chain risk-taking (perps, options, NFT trading) Time-weighted holdings across degen-adjacent assets Notable community participation

guide.title: 领取你的战利品宝箱
guide.description: 在 14 天领取时间窗口内从大厅领取可用宝箱。宝箱转换为 $RSGP 分配，与合格钱包相关的任何东西也会自动发送到 TGE。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: Claim available chests from the lobby within the 14-day claim window. Chests convert into $RSGP allocations, and anything tied to an eligible wallet is also sent automatically at TGE.

guide.title: 为你的钱包充值以玩游戏
guide.description: 玩地牢和淘金热需要 USDC 或 ETH 来获取风险密钥和游戏内费用。Bridge 资金交换和跨 30 多条链跨链，无需离开此页面。路线快捷，费用低廉。立即跨链打开交互式跨链组件在新标签页中打开跨链
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: Playing Dungeons and Gold Rush takes USDC or ETH for Risk Keys and in-game costs. Bridge funds Swap and bridge across 30+ chains without leaving this page. Fast routes, low fees. Bridge now Opens an interactive bridge widget Open the bridge in a new tab

guide.title: 玩地牢以获得战利品和积分
guide.description: 以约 0.1 USDC 的价格购买风险密钥并运行地牢。成功提取，你保留战利品；死在里面，你失去了钥匙的桩。在皇家金库兑换成创世纪空投积分时，你可以在任何游戏内货币之上兑换兑现。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_title: Play Dungeons for Loot and Points
guide.original_description: Buy a Risk Key for about 0.1 USDC and run a dungeon. Extract successfully and you keep the loot; die inside and you lose the key’s stake. Loot you cash out at the Royal Treasury converts into Genesis Airdrop points on top of any in-game currency.

guide.title: 通过对决竞技场和辅助活动赚取积分
guide.description: 决斗竞技场可让你在一对一的战斗中与其他玩家直接下注，而坑战、岛上钓鱼和酒吧游戏等支线活动在更大的跑动之间会产生更小、更稳定的点滴。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_title: Earn Points Through Duel Arena and Side Activities
guide.original_description: Duel Arena lets you wager directly against other players in 1v1 fights, and side activities like Pit Fights, island fishing, and bar games generate smaller, steady point drips between bigger runs.

guide.title: 铸造皇家宪章，赚取全季收入
guide.description: 在淘金热季节，铸造皇家宪章可解锁全部收入功能和每日能量再生。没有一个，你仍然可以玩，但你的积分积累是有上限的。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_title: Mint a Royal Charter for Full Seasonal Earning
guide.original_description: During Gold Rush seasons, minting a Royal Charter unlocks full earning features and daily energy regeneration. Without one, you can still play, but your point accumulation is capped.
